mainEntity.name: Can keyed paint be fixed without repainting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, if the scratch is only in the clear coat. We polish the area and blend it. If the key went through to primer or metal, the panel needs paint, which is body-shop work; we will tell you which case you have before any work starts.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a police report?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a vandalism or theft claim your insurer will usually want a report number. For the estimate itself we do not need it, so send photos first and file the report in parallel.

mainEntity.name: Should I file a claim or pay out of pocket?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is your call, and it is easier with numbers: we write the itemized estimate first so you can compare it against your deductible. Ask your insurer or agent how a claim could affect your premium — only they can answer that.

mainEntity.name: How thorough is the glass cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tempered glass spreads into seat tracks, door cavities, vents and under the carpet, so we remove seats and trim where needed and vacuum, brush and blow those areas out — far beyond what a household vacuum can reach.

It depends on the damage. Light scratch polishing and glass cleanup is often a same-day or next-day job once scheduled; interior repairs take longer. We give you a time estimate with the written estimate.
